programs.name: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM)
programs.feeNote: Self-sponsored fee for the 2025-27 batch per IMI Delhi Mandatory Disclosure (company-sponsored: INR 36,97,160; 2024-26 batch self-sponsored: INR 20,95,230). The 2027 admissions page FAQ also states the programme fee as INR 23.54 lakh. Inclusions (hostel etc.) not itemised in these sources.
programs.intakeNote: AICTE-approved batch strength for 2-year PGDM (includes the 18-month PGDM) per Mandatory Disclosure; admissions page FAQ also lists PGDM 300, PGDM (HRM) 60, PGDM (B&FS) 60. The 2024-26 graduating PGDM cohort was 283.
programs.placementNote: IMI Delhi Final Placement Report 2024-26, PGDM programme figures (median 17.38 LPA, average 18.65 LPA, highest 68.66 LPA). Overall across PGDM/HRM/B&FS (414 students): median 17.20 LPA, average 18.08 LPA. Report does not mention an audit.

selectionProcess.name: Application with valid CAT/XAT/GMAT score
selectionProcess.detail: Applicants evaluated on CAT/XAT/GMAT scores, past academic performance and work experience; no fixed cut-off and no category reservation (per admissions FAQ).

selectionProcess.name: Video Assessment
selectionProcess.detail: Video assessment tests thought process and communication skills; shortlisted candidates move to PI.

selectionProcess.name: Personal Interview
selectionProcess.detail: Assesses general and business awareness, clarity of goals, attitude, people skills, communication, extra-curricular/professional initiatives.

keyDates.notes: 2027 intake (Round 2 per admissions page): application opens Sept 2026; last date 19 Dec 2026; interviews Jan 2027; admission decision Feb 2027; programme begins Jul 2027. Exam date not set by IMI (CAT/XAT/GMAT).
